title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness

translated_title: 智能体记忆即推荐：面向大语言模型智能体长期记忆的推荐系统设计
translated_abstract: 在多次会话中为用户提供服务的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，必须在每次请求时从存储的记忆中挑选出少数几条进入有限的上下文窗口。这一选择在很大程度上决定了智能体能否正确回答问题，并且需要在网络规模下对每次请求执行。这一选择面临三个挑战：庞大且不断增长的存储库、每次请求的成本预算限制，以及需要全部证据的多会话问题。许多记忆系统在构建笔记或图结构时，每份历史记录需要数百到数千次LLM调用，且各系统都是独立设计的，因此难以确定究竟是哪个组件带来了准确性。这些挑战与推荐系统的特性高度相似，因此我们将智能体记忆形式化为预算约束下的板块推荐：请求对应用户，存储的记忆对应物品，上下文窗口对应板块。这一形式化将记忆系统置于推荐级联的统一设计空间中，并将准确性分解为完整性……
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是将LLM智能体的记忆选择问题形式化为预算约束下的板块推荐问题（请求为用户、记忆为物品、上下文窗口为板块），从而把各种智能体记忆系统统一纳入推荐级联的设计空间，并将准确性分解为可分析的组件。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes agent memory selection as budgeted slate recommendation—with requests as users, memories as items, and the context window as a slate—unifying LLM agent memory systems within a single design space of recommender cascades and factorizing accuracy into analyzable components.
